_comment: Cards that exist only for the reveal-as-drawn test (tests/unit/replacement/test_reveal_first_draw.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_rfd_inquisitor` is Inquisitor Eisenhorn's first paragraph on a free body; `t_rfd_etchings` is Primitive Etchings' mandatory reveal, free.
